_comment: Gamification vs task zones on the Screen surface, in normalized [0,1] coordinates (origin top-left). Frame = display-panel rectangle (derived by rectifying assets/gamified_points.jpeg; screen corner tags 12/13/15 do not decode reliably). When the analyzer's Screen surface is defined to this same display-panel rectangle, gaze and zones share one frame. Zone LOCATIONS are fixed across gamified states (the bar fills / counter changes, but regions stay put). Status: extracted 2026-07-01, pending physical-coordinate refinement.
